mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PERM_CHANGE_LOG (CHANGED_AT, ACTOR_EMP_NO, TARGET_EMP_NO, ITEM, BEFORE_VALUE, AFTER_VALUE) VALUES (#{changedAt}, #{actorEmpNo}, #{targetEmpNo}, #{item}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue})
mapper.select: SELECT CHG_ID, CHANGED_AT, ACTOR_EMP_NO, TARGET_EMP_NO, ITEM, BEFORE_VALUE, AFTER_VALUE FROM PERM_CHANGE_LOG TARGET_EMP_NO = #{targetEmpNo} ORDER BY CHG_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
